name: edit
description: Edit a file by replacing a specific string with a new string. The oldString must be unique in the file unless replaceAll is true. Use replaceAll to replace all occurrences.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to edit.

oldString.description: The exact string to find in the file.

newString.description: The string to replace oldString with.

replaceAll.description: If true, replace all occurrences of oldString (default false).
